newsitem.title: UK: TVA eyes 10-year mark global bond - dealers.
newsitem.headline: TVA eyes 10-year mark global bond - dealers.

text.p: The Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA) may launch a 10-year global bond for up to one billion marks, syndicate managers said on Friday.

TVA will hold investor presentations in Frankfurt on Monday. The meetings were arranged by Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and Lehman Brothers, but officials there declined to comment on whether a bond issue would follow.
Other syndicate managers in Frankfurt said a one billion 10-year mark deal was being considered by TVA, and such an issue would establish a new benchmark in the sector.
Spread talk was between 16 and 20 basis points over Bunds.
"TVA would definitely opt for a longer maturity," said a syndicate head at one bank.
"There is too much paper in the five-year sector, and demand from Asian investors at that maturity is not strong. At 10 years there is more appetite from them," he said.
TVA first ventured into the international bond markets last year, when it launched dollar bonds at five, 10 and 30 years.
TVA supplies electric power in seven states and is rated triple-A by both Moody's and Standard & Poor's.
